'''Tenara''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was located in the [[Tenara system/Legends|Tenara system]]. It was situated in the [[Back Reach]] area of the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]], within the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. A small [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] connected Tenara to the planet [[Korphir]].<ref name="TEA" />

[[Standard century/Legends|Centuries]] before<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[43 ABY]],<ref name="date">The main section of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' ends with a mention of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]]'s journey across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the beginning of which is depicted in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''. The events of that novel are dated to [[43 ABY]] by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> Tenara served as a bolt-hole for [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] from Korphir. The pirates used hidden vaults on Tenara to stash their stolen loot, and the planet gained a reputation as a fabled treasure world as a result.<ref name="TEA" />

By 43 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]],<ref name="date" /> Tenara was no longer used by the [[Korphiri]] pirates as a hide-out, and was instead a [[Agriworld/Legends|farming world]]. Tenara's inhabitants offered sightseeing tours of the old and dusty pirate hiding places in order to earn extra [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tenara was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the planet in grid square Q-6.<ref name="TEA" />
